cohort: 49 neonates with a prenatal diagnosis of meconium peritonitis (MP), born at Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center between January 2011 and December 2016.
finding: A combination of prenatal ultrasound features (polyhydramnios, persistence of peritoneal fluid) and maternal characteristics (maternal intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy) correctly predicted 70.0% of neonates requiring surgery, while prediction of poor outcome based on these factors did not perform as well.
